definitions.users_positive_ts: Distinct trimmed nonblank cli_ip on raw_ts_requests > 0 rows; the sponsor deck user definition.
definitions.users_all: Distinct trimmed nonblank cli_ip across supplied rows; not necessarily all source traffic.
definitions.device_ids: Distinct trimmed nonblank device_id; not comparable to Grafana approximate uniq including blank IDs.
definitions.ts_requests: SUM(raw_ts_requests). No HTTP status, segment path or duration columns exist in this file.

warnings: Only dates represented in Parquet are included; absent dates are not zero.
ReqHost names are reused across events. Host filters alone do not certify event mapping.
HTTP status and TS path rules cannot be checked from this Parquet.
Distinct daily users must not be summed to calculate period users.
